user.title: Enedis entreprise (R6X)
user.description: Where do the files sent by Enedis arrive?

sftp.title: External SFTP server
sftp.description: Server outside your site on which Enedis deposits the files. Home Assistant connects to it; files are only downloaded, never deleted.

data_description.host_key: Optional (SHA256:…). Left empty, the key the server shows now is recorded; a server showing another key later is refused.
data_description.key: 64 hexadecimal characters, from the contact channel in the Enedis business account.

folder.title: Local folder
folder.description: Folder that receives the Enedis files. Nothing in it is deleted or moved.

data_description.key: 64 hexadecimal characters, from the contact channel in the Enedis business account. Leave empty if the files are already decrypted.

ftps.title: External FTPS server
ftps.description: Server that receives the Enedis files. Files are only downloaded, never deleted.

data_description.key: 64 hexadecimal characters, from the contact channel in the Enedis business account.

error.invalid_key: The key must be 64 hexadecimal characters.
error.cannot_connect: The source cannot be reached. Check the address, the credentials and the folder.

abort.mail_source_removed: The mailbox (IMAP) source no longer exists: delete this entry and add the integration again with an SFTP server or a local folder.

data.no_file_days: Alert after this many days without a file

data_description.prms: PRM numbers (14 digits) separated by commas. Empty: every meter found in the files.

import_history.title: Import a history file
import_history.description: One-off import of a load curve exported from the Enedis portal (CSV with the columns debut;kw_moyen). Points already received from Enedis are kept unless you choose to overwrite them.

data_description.prm: Meter the file belongs to (14 digits).

error.history_unreadable: The file is not a history export (first line: debut;kw_moyen).

abort.history_imported: History imported: {points} points, {hours} hours written to the statistics.

undecryptable.title: Enedis files cannot be decrypted
undecryptable.description: {count} file(s) could not be decrypted. The key of the contact channel has probably changed: copy the current key from the Enedis business account and reconfigure the integration. The files are kept and will be read again.

no_file.title: No Enedis file received
no_file.description: No file has been received for {count} days. Check that the recurring publications are still active in the Enedis business account and that the contact channel still works.

mail_source_removed.title: The mailbox source was removed
mail_source_removed.description: The mailbox (IMAP) source no longer exists in this version. Delete this entry of the integration, then add it again and choose the SFTP server (or a local folder) the Enedis files arrive on. The statistics already imported are kept.

last_day_peak.name: Peak of the last complete day

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: One-off import of a load curve exported from the Enedis portal (CSV with the columns debut;kw_moyen) into the statistics.

path.name: File
path.description: Path of the CSV file, in a folder Home Assistant is allowed to read.

prm.name: PRM
prm.description: Meter the file belongs to (14 digits).

config_entry_id.name: Configuration
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when the integration is set up several times.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace points already received from Enedis publications.

entry_not_found.message: No loaded configuration matches: give the configuration to use.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant is not allowed to read this path.

history_unreadable.message: The history file cannot be read: {error}

mail_source_removed.message: The mailbox (IMAP) source no longer exists: delete this entry and add the integration again with an SFTP server or a local folder.
